summary: Social discussion highlights: vendor releases (Cloudflare, DeepSeek, Claude/Anthropic), several operator-facing incident/workflow reports (agent file access, MCP cautions, DeepSeek-cyberattack), plus infra-primitive chatter on sandboxes and memory design. | Vendor product and infra deltas: Anthropic Opus 5 and Google/Vercel GA/features lead product headlines; Cloudflare, Daytona, Modal, Vercel and Supabase add runtime/sandbox/MCP infra; JetBrains and Google posts include operator guidance. | GitHub snapshot: mix of large agent platforms, vendor CLIs/releases, and emerging infra primitives (sandboxes, memory, security). No social/operator field reports in this shard; many repo-only signals need second-source corroboration. | Package-scoped signals show active growth in local-first agent memory, eval tools, MCP servers, and sandbox/orchestration primitives; missing vendor changelogs and social operator reports.
